title: Archive Delivery Receipt
description: Extension fields for delivery-receipt-<timestamp>.json. Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Written by Archive as the master I10 completion record.

receipts_aggregated.description: Count of receipts read during aggregation. Minimum 1 (at least one wave receipt required).

not_tested_items.description: Total count of not_tested items aggregated from all receipts. Verbatim in delivery receipt.

not_tested_list.description: Aggregated not_tested items from all receipts. Deduplicated exact duplicates; distinct items preserved. Becomes starting scope for next related session.

version_bump_reason.description: BREAKING = major bump. ADDITIVE = minor bump. COSMETIC = patch bump.

waves_completed.description: Count of waves that completed with Verifier PASS

waves_planned.description: Count of waves declared in the decompose plan

all_waves_passed.description: True only when waves_completed = waves_planned and no wave receipt has status FAIL

missing_receipts.description: Required receipt files that were absent. Populated only on FAIL status. Empty on PASS.

changelog_path.description: Path to CHANGELOG.md where the new entry was appended

version_file_path.description: Path to VERSION file that was bumped
